Scope: Aziz's 560 companies and the `{python} f.n_universe` we keep, the training / holdout split, the website
text, and what is kept out (EV/EBITDA never enters comp finding).

Facts available:

- `f.n_supplied` = `{python} f.n_supplied`: companies supplied
- `f.n_us_hq` = `{python} f.n_us_hq`: of those, headquartered in the US
- `f.ev_ebitda_min` = `{python} f.ev_ebitda_min`, `f.ev_ebitda_max` = `{python} f.ev_ebitda_max`: ends of the EV/EBITDA range kept
- `f.n_dropped_multiple` = `{python} f.n_dropped_multiple`: companies dropped by that range
- `f.n_dropped_above` = `{python} f.n_dropped_above`, `f.n_dropped_below` = `{python} f.n_dropped_below`: of those, above and below the range
- `f.n_universe` = `{python} f.n_universe`: companies in the universe after the filters
- `f.n_sic2` = `{python} f.n_sic2`: SIC 2-digit codes in the universe
- `f.n_training` = `{python} f.n_training`: training companies
- `f.n_holdout` = `{python} f.n_holdout`: holdout companies
- `f.train_share` = `{python} f.train_share`: share of each stratum put in training
- `f.n_strata` = `{python} f.n_strata`: split strata (SIC2 codes with at least `f.min_stratum` companies, plus "other")
- `f.min_stratum` = `{python} f.min_stratum`: smallest SIC2 code kept as its own stratum
- `f.n_split_forced` = `{python} f.n_split_forced`: showcase targets forced into training
- `f.n_web_text` = `{python} f.n_web_text`: universe companies with cleaned website text
- `f.n_web_no_text` = `{python} f.n_web_no_text`: universe companies without (no page, bot check, or nothing left after cleaning)
- `f.web_max_pages` = `{python} f.web_max_pages`: pages kept per company, at most
- `f.web_words_median` = `{python} f.web_words_median`: median cleaned words per company (companies with text)

Figures available:

- @tbl-funnel: companies left after each filter (01 notebook, section 3.1)
- @fig-divisions: universe companies per SIC division, training and holdout
